parts.name: Root
parts.description: The table container with the state. It makes an interactive grid above native table markup. It controls the focus, the selection, the sort, the column widths, and the column visibility.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The number of the rows that the user can select: 'none', 'single', or 'multiple'.

props.name: keyboardNavigation
props.description:
How far the roving tab stop goes into the body. The default is `'grid'`.

The cell navigation has a cost. Each body cell registers itself and calculates its own focus
state. A virtualized table does this again for each block of rows that it makes while the user
scrolls.

With `'row'`, the keyboard still reaches the body, at one focus target for each row. With
`'none'`, the body takes no focus. Use `'none'` only when nothing in the body does an action.
In each mode, the header keeps its own navigation, and with it the sort control and the width
control.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: With 'toggle', the user can remove the selection of a selected row. With 'replace', a selected row stays selected when the user presses it again.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: With 'all', a disabled row does nothing. With 'selection', the user cannot select a disabled row, but the row does its other operations.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Stops the user from the removal of the last selected row.

props.name: hiddenColumns
props.description: The list of the ids of the hidden columns. You can bind it. A hidden column keeps its width, thus you can show it again with that width.

props.name: defaultHiddenColumns
props.description: The ids of the hidden columns at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: The set of the ids of the selected rows. You can bind it.

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: The ids of the selected rows at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: sortDescriptor
props.description: The sort state: the column id and the direction. You can bind it. Set it to undefined to remove the sort.

props.name: defaultSortDescriptor
props.description: The sort state at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: columnWidths
props.description: The column widths, by column id. You can bind it. A width can be in px, in '%', or in 'fr'.

props.name: defaultColumnWidths
props.description: The column widths at the start, for when the component controls the state. The user can still change them.

props.name: ssrMinTableWidth
props.description:
The width that the table keeps with `min-width` on the server, in px, before the columns
register their own widths.

On the server, the `<table>` element goes to the output before the column children register.
Thus the table does not know its own minimum width, and it takes the width of its container. At
the hydration, the column widths can make the table wider, and the layout moves.

Set this prop to the sum of the column widths to keep that space from the start. On the client,
the component ignores it after the columns register.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: The ids of the rows that stay in the table and obey `disabledBehavior`.

props.name: onRowAction
props.description: The component calls it with the row id when the user activates a row.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: The component calls it when the row selection changes.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: The component calls it when the sort state changes. It receives undefined when the sort goes away.

props.name: onColumnWidthsChange
props.description: The component calls it when the column widths change.

props.name: onHiddenColumnsChange
props.description: The component calls it when the column visibility changes.

props.name: onColumnResizeStart
props.description: The component calls it with the column id when the user starts to change a width.

props.name: onColumnResizeEnd
props.description: The component calls it with the final widths when the user stops the width change.

props.name: children
props.description: The header part, the body part, and the foot part.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable object with the state of the table, for a complex composition.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the table element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled-behavior
dataAttributes.description: The configured disabled behavior ('all' | 'selection').

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while a focus in the table must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the table.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-behavior
dataAttributes.description: The configured selection behavior ('toggle' | 'replace').

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-mode
dataAttributes.description: The configured selection mode ('none' | 'single' | 'multiple').

dataAttributes.name: data-table-column-resizer
dataAttributes.description: Marks a handle that changes a column width. If the table has one, the root changes to a fixed table layout.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-implicit-width
dataAttributes.description: Present on the col element of a column while the column still has an implicit width. The first width change removes it.

parts.name: Column
parts.description: The data of a column. It makes no DOM of its own. It registers the column, and it must contain one Table.ColumnHeaderCell.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id of the column, for the sort, the visibility, and the width.

props.name: rowHeader
props.description: Makes each body cell of this column a rowheader.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The name of the column in the polite sort announcements, for when that name is not the column id.

props.name: width
props.description: The fixed width, in px, in '%', or in 'fr'. A column with a fixed width does not change its width, also with a resize handle in it.

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: The width at the start, for when the component controls it. The user can still change it.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: The smallest width of the column, in px.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: The largest width of the column, in px.

props.name: pin
props.description:
Keeps the column at an edge of the horizontal scroll: `'left'` at the start, and `'right'` at
the end. More than one column can go to the same side. They go in the sequence of the document.
The table calculates the position of each one from the widths of the columns already at that
side.

props.name: children
props.description: The one Table.ColumnHeaderCell in this column.

parts.name: Header
parts.description: The head section of the table. It contains the header row.

props.name: children
props.description: The header row and its columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-header
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the header element.

parts.name: Body
parts.description: The body section of the table. It contains the data rows and the empty state.

props.name: items
props.description: The array of the row data. Each item goes through the children snippet.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description: The virtualization settings. With them, the component makes only the rows that the user sees, for a large collection.

props.name: empty
props.description: The snippet for when `items` is empty.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present while the body has no rows.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-body
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the body element.

dataAttributes.name: data-virtual-spacer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the top spacer row or the bottom spacer row of the virtualization ('top' | 'bottom').

parts.name: EmptyState
parts.description: The row that the body shows while the table has no data rows. Use it, and do not make your own body content with a condition.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the empty state.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the empty state row.

parts.name: Footer
parts.description: The foot section of the table, for the summary rows.

props.name: children
props.description: The rows of the foot.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-footer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the footer element.

parts.name: Row
parts.description: One row of the table. Give each body row an id, for the selection, the focus movement, and the row actions.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id of the row, for the selection, the disabled state, and the row actions.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this row, and the `disabledBehavior` of the root sets the result.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The plain-text description of the row, for the announcements to assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: The cells of the row.

dataAttributes.name: data-actionable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row runs a row action on activation.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row has the focus and the focus must be visible.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while an element in the row has a focus that must be visible.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the row.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row itself has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the user cannot select the row.

parts.name: ColumnHeaderCell
parts.description: One header cell. It stays the roving-focus target of its column, also when it contains a sort trigger or a resize handle.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the header cell. It can also contain a Table.SortTrigger and a Table.ColumnResizer.

dataAttributes.name: data-column-index
dataAttributes.description: Index of the cell's column among visible columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has the focus and the focus must be visible.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while an element in the cell has a focus that must be visible.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pin-edge
dataAttributes.description: The edge the owning column is pinned to ('left' | 'right').

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-sort-direction
dataAttributes.description: The sort direction while this column is the sort column ('ascending' | 'descending').

dataAttributes.name: data-sortable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is sortable.

parts.name: SortTrigger
parts.description: The button that sorts. Put it in a header cell to make that column sortable. It changes the sortDescriptor of the root.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the trigger. As a snippet, it can receive a `sortDirection` render state, for a name or a mark that follows the sort.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-sort-direction
dataAttributes.description: The sort direction while the owning column is the sort column ('ascending' | 'descending').

dataAttributes.name: data-sorted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the owning column is the active sort column.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-sort-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the sort trigger element.

parts.name: ColumnResizer
parts.description: A handle that changes the width, and the keyboard can operate it. Put it in a header cell to let the user change the width of that column.

props.name: step
props.description: The width change for one arrow key, in px, in the keyboard resize mode.

props.name: shiftStep
props.description: The width change for one arrow key while the user holds `Shift`, in px.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the handle.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the handle has the focus and the focus must be visible.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the handle has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the user can change the width of the owning column now.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizable-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction of the width change from this handle. Today it is always 'right'.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the user changes the width with a pointer or with the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-column-resizer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the resize handle element.

dataAttributes.name: data-testid
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden live region for the width status ('column-resize-status'). Do not write styles for it.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: A selection control, in a header cell or in a body cell. In a header cell, it is in the DOM only when selectionMode is 'multiple'. When the selection is off, it is in the DOM nowhere.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the checkbox. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: title
props.description: The native tooltip text of the checkbox.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the checkbox, usually a `Table.CheckboxIndicator`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name, for when the user sees no name.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the checkbox its name.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-checkbox
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the checkbox element.

parts.name: CheckboxIndicator
parts.description: The mark in a table checkbox. Use it to make your own marks for the checked state and the indeterminate state.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the indicator in the DOM, also while the checkbox is not checked.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the indicator, usually a check icon or a minus icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is indeterminate, because only some rows are selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is unchecked (with `forceMount`).

parts.name: Cell
parts.description: A cell of the body or of the foot, in the grid keyboard operation. A body cell in the first column becomes a rowheader when its column has rowHeader.

dataAttributes.name: data-actionable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row of the cell runs a row action on activation.

dataAttributes.name: data-column-index
dataAttributes.description: Index of the cell's column among visible columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the cell's row is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has the focus and the focus must be visible.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pin-edge
dataAttributes.description: The edge the owning column is pinned to ('left' | 'right').

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-row-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell's row is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the user cannot select the row of the cell.

parts.name: InteractiveCell
parts.description: A body cell for content that has its own controls. While the focus is on the cell, the grid keyboard operation continues. While the focus is on a control in the cell, that control gets the keys.

dataAttributes.name: data-actionable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row of the cell runs a row action on activation.

dataAttributes.name: data-column-index
dataAttributes.description: Index of the cell's column among visible columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the cell's row is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has the focus and the focus must be visible.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pin-edge
dataAttributes.description: The edge the owning column is pinned to ('left' | 'right').

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-row-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell's row is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the user cannot select the row of the cell.
